Forklift driver - polyvalent job

FUNCTIE OMSCHRIJVING

For a company in the Waregem area, I am looking for a polyvalent forklift driver.

Tasks:

• Operating gasoline-powered forklifts.
• Performing tasks without a forklift, such as hosing down trucks and containers.
• Working around live chickens.

PROFIEL

• You have a lot of experience with a forklift.
• You are in possession of a valid forklift certificate.
• You are flexible in hours. You start at 5am, but end times varies.
• You want to work in the area of chickens
• We can count on you 
• You can speak sufficient English. French is a plus.

AANBOD

• A fun job
• An attractive salary package

The company is a leading player in waste management, specialising in the sorting, processing and recycling of various waste streams. It continuously invests in new technologies to efficiently separate recyclable materials within a circular economy.
Multiple sites are located across Belgium.

Jobomschrijving

What will you do as a Hooklift Truck Driver?
	
• Transport, collect and place roll-off containers at customer locations	
• Secure containers with cover nets or tarps to ensure safe transport	
• Alternate between driving and manual work on-site	
• Respond to customer questions in a friendly and professional manner

What are we looking for in a Driver C/CE with Hooklift Experience?
	
• Driving licence C or CE; only C but motivated to drive with a trailer? CE can be obtained internally	
• Experience as a driver is an advantage but not required	
• You are an early starter (between 4 a.m. and 6 a.m.)	
• You speak Dutch, English or French for safety instructions

Place of employment - Groot-Bijgaarden

Jobomschrijving

For our client, an international organization active in Aftermarket services for advanced mobility systems, we are looking for a  Technical Customer Trainer who can step in and make an impact. The company focuses on the sales, service, and technical support of advanced powertrain, transmission, and chassis technologies for passenger cars, commercial vehicles, and industrial applications. From Brussels, they support mobility solutions delivered worldwide.

Your Role
	
• As a Technical Customer Trainer, you will be responsible for transferring technical knowledge to customers, workshops, fleets, and service partners. You will act as a key technical contact, ensuring that customers have the knowledge and tools needed to effectively use and maintain products and systems.
Key Responsibilities:

Training & Knowledge Transfer
	
• Deliver technical training programs to customers, service partners, and network organizations.	
• Ensure accurate and effective transfer of technical product and system knowledge. 	
• Develop new training programs that respond to market demands and customer needs.	
• Create and maintain training-related system access and software credentials where required.	
• Conduct on-site customer training sessions and technical presentations at customer events.
Technical Support
	
• Provide technical support to aftermarket customers.	
• Assist customers with technical questions related to products and systems.	
• Serve as a subject matter expert for technical solutions and applications. 
Customer & Network Development
	
• Maintain strong relationships with service workshops, fleets, and industry partners. 	
• Support the development and maintenance of commercial service networks.	
• Identify training opportunities and emerging market needs.

Your Profile:

Qualifications & Experience
	
• You must have experience providing technical training in the automotive sector.	
• Strong technical knowledge of commercial vehicle systems and products.	
• Extensive experience within the automotive commercial vehicle sector, particularly involving trucks, buses, trailers, and air brake systems. 	
• Experience delivering technical training, coaching, or technical customer support. 	
• Well-established network within the commercial vehicle service industry is considered an advantage. 
 

Language Skills
	
• Fluent in Dutch, French, and English, both spoken and written.	
• Comfortable delivering training sessions to international audiences and expatriate teams. 
Personal Competencies
	
• Excellent presentation and communication skills.	
• Passion for teaching and developing others.	
• Customer-oriented and solution-focused mindset. 	
• Highly motivated to learn and master new technologies and product portfolios.	
• Flexible and willing to adapt to customer requirements and training locations. 	
• Strong organizational and stakeholder management skills.

Our client is a major player in the logistics sector. They handle road transport, air freight, and sea freight.

The Antwerp branch is responsible for everything related to ocean freight. Around 100 employees work there and give their best every day to provide the highest possible level of service. They are seated in groups of four colleagues at work islands, spread over two floors. The atmosphere on the work floor is calm—sometimes hectic—but very pleasant. There is strong teamwork, and there is certainly room for regular laughter as well.

Every two weeks, a fruit basket is delivered to the departments. In addition, you can work with flexible hours, there are various opportunities for personal development, and subscriptions for the toll tunnel and the water bus are fully reimbursed.

In short: a very attractive employer!

Jobomschrijving

Are you detail-oriented and passionate about data, pricing, and ocean freight? 

As a Rate Management Specialist, you’ll play a key role in ensuring accurate and efficient pricing processes that power our global operations.

You’ll manage customer contracts, tariffs, and costing data across our systems, enabling seamless auto-rating and auto-costing and supporting our journey toward full digitalization.

Working closely with commercial, operational, and system teams, you will help deliver tailored pricing solutions that meet customer requirements while supporting ongoing digitalization and process improvement initiatives. This position is essential in maintaining data integrity and optimizing the performance of our global rating platforms.

	
• Strong attention to detail and analytical mindset	
• Experience in Ocean Freight pricing or operations (minimum 2 years)	
• Strong communication and collaboration skills	
• Proficiency in Microsoft 365	
• Fluent English and Dutch

Our International Commercial Operations Graduate Program is a unique three-year development journey designed for ambitious graduates and young professionals with the potential and drive to become tomorrow's business leaders. From day one, you will gain hands-on experience, work on high-impact projects, and develop the strategic, analytical, and leadership capabilities required to excel in commercial, business transformation, and operational leadership roles.

Client Details

Our client is a leading international manufacturing company with a strong presence across Europe and beyond.

Description

Throughout the program, you will gain a comprehensive understanding of how a large international organization serves customers across multiple markets and drives commercial performance through data, technology, and process excellence.

• Three rotations of 9-12 months across different Commercial Excellence and Operations functions
• Exposure to multiple countries within an international business environment
• Cross-functional collaboration with Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Business Leadership teams
• Direct interaction with senior management and key decision-makers
• Ownership of meaningful projects with visible business impact
• Structured learning and development curriculum focused on business excellence, digital transformation, and leadership
• Dedicated support from a mentor and buddy from the start of the program

What You Will Learn

During the program, you will build expertise in:

• Commercial strategy and performance management
• Business analytics and data-driven decision-making
• Digital transformation and technology-enabled processes
• Process optimization and continuous improvement
• Stakeholder management and effective communication
• Leadership, professional development, and change management
You will work alongside experienced professionals who are committed to helping you successfully transition from academia into a thriving international career.

We are seeking curious, analytical, and ambitious individuals who are eager to challenge conventional thinking and make a real impact.

Requirements

• Master's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Data Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Management, or a related field
• Recent graduate or expected graduation from 2026 onwards
• Initial professional experience through internships, student jobs, or a first role is an asset
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Passion for technology, digital innovation, and business transformation
• Proactive mindset with the confidence to challenge the status quo
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills
• Professional proficiency in English, Dutch, and French

Are you an Inside Sales Representative with experience in the food industry and strong language skills in English plus German, Danish, Swedish or Portuguese? Apply today and join an international trading environment.

Your role as an Inside Sales Representative
For an international company active in the food sector, we are looking for an Inside Sales Representative to support and expand commercial relationships within the meat industry. As a Sales Support Specialist and Internal Account Manager, you will be responsible for managing customer relationships and ensuring smooth follow-up of the entire sales process.

Your responsibilities:
 
• Manage and develop an existing customer portfolio. 
• Prepare, send and follow up on quotations. 
• Maintain regular contact with restaurants, hotels and retail customers. 
• Identify commercial opportunities and support business growth. 
• Coordinate customer requests and monitor deliveries. 
• Participate in trade fairs and industry events when required. 
• Collaborate closely with internal teams and international partners.
Your profile as an Inside Sales Representative / Internal Account Manager
 
• You have experience in an inside sales, sales support, customer service or commercial administration role. 
• Experience in the food industry. 
• Experience within the meat sector is considered a significant advantage. 
• You communicate fluently in English and at least one of the following languages: German, Danish, Swedish or Portuguese. 
• You have experience with customer follow-up, quotation management and commercial administration. 
• You are comfortable working with common office software and digital systems. 
• You are willing to attend trade fairs on an occasional basis.

jobs.occupation: Sales Associate - Chocolate Boutique - Bruges City Centre
jobs.description:
Are you looking for an exciting opportunity in the heart of Bruges?

Do you want a job with real growth potential? Are you passionate about customer service and working with high-quality products?

Then this might be the perfect opportunity for you.

This renowned chocolate boutique, located in the historic centre of Bruges, specialises in premium Belgian chocolate and offers customers an authentic chocolate experience.

The shop is known for its wide selection of pralines, truffles, and other handcrafted chocolate delicacies, all made with passion and craftmanship.

We are currently looking for an enthusiastic and customer oriented Sales Associate to join their team.

Your daily responsibilities:

• Welcoming and assisting customers

• Replenishing stock and maintaining attractive product displays

• Handling payments and operating the cash register

• Providing information about the product range

• Performing accurate stock control and monitoring expire dates

• Maintaining a warm and welcoming attitude at all times

• Perfect English and basic Dutch, but willingness to learn

• Willingness to work weekends (1 day off during the weekend)

• Evening work: in July & August, closing time is 10 PM (maximum 11 closing shifts per month)

French, Spanish, Russian, Chinese are also languages we are looking for.

Operator / Bender - Zwevegem

FUNCTIE OMSCHRIJVING

Do you have a passion for technology and are you looking for a challenging job with responsibility?
Become a bending machine operator in an innovative production environment! You'll bend pipes of various sizes, cut them to length where needed, and remove burrs. The work can be physically demanding, especially with larger pipes. Experience in the metal industry is a strong plus.

What are you tasks?

• 
Operate and set up the bending machine to ensure precise pipe shaping.

• 
Monitor the process and intervene in case of malfunctions to guarantee a perfect end product.

• 
2-shift system!

Dutch and/or English language skills are required.

PROFIEL

Your profile:

• 
You have technical knowledge or experience in a similar role.

• 
Accuracy and attention to detail are your strong suits.

• 
You are eager to learn and interested in automation and production processes.

• 
You can work independently, but also thrive in a team environment.

• 
Safety and quality are always your top priorities.

AANBOD

Our offer:

• 
A stable job in an innovative production environment.

• 
Competitive salary with extra benefits – salary + 12.50% shift bonus.

• 
Internal training and opportunities for growth.

• 
Work in a dynamic team with a positive and supportive atmosphere.

STUDIEVEREISTEN
Geen specifieke studievereisten
.

Operator - Zwevegem - weekend (ENG)

FUNCTIE OMSCHRIJVING

We are looking for a technically minded operator who enjoys practical work and wants to learn new things. You will operate and monitor various advanced machines:

• Tricantors: Separating oil from other materials – high-quality machines that require a delicate touch to operate.
• Shredder: Reducing the size of filter cloths.
• Vogelsang installation: Technical installations that require precision and attention
In addition, you will remain calm and focused when problems arise while multiple machines are running.

Working environment

• Greasy environment – work clothes and boots get dirty and smell of frying oil.
• Hands-on mentality required.
• Willingness to work varying shifts.
Working hours

Saturday: 12:00 noon to 12:00 midnight.

Sunday: 8:00 p.m. to 8:00 a.m.

PROFIEL

Profile

• You're not afraid to get your hands dirty 
• Technical profile is compulsory
• Good knowledge of Dutch, French or English 
• Experience as operator or higher education is a plus
• A stable CV

AANBOD

What do we offer?

• Competitive salary starting at €17/hour
• The company will be moving to Lokeren in 2027
• Varied and technically challenging work for those who enjoy working with their hands
• Quick start!

STUDIEVEREISTEN
Geen specifieke studievereisten
.

Forklift drivers - 2 shifts - region Desselgem

FUNCTIE OMSCHRIJVING

Do you have experience as a forklift driver and a valid forklift certificate?

Are you willing to work in shifts and in a fast-paced production environment?

This internationally growing production company specializes in innovative solutions for the construction and interior sector and is known for its strong focus on quality and sustainability. They are currently looking for forklift drivers to join their team in Desselgem in a stable and modern working environment.

What will you do?

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Transporting goods within the warehouse

• SCanning and checking incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse clean and organized

PROFIEL

• Forklift certificate

• Willing to work in shifts

AANBOD

What do we offer?

• Attractive salary 
• Stable job in an international company

jobs.employer_name: Science at Work Staffing België BV
jobs.description:
Our client in the Netherlands, distributor in equipment, consumables and reagents for life sciences industry and universities, we are looking for a Sales manager (Brussels/Wallonia/ Luxemburg region) for a permanent position.
 

Verantwoordelijkheden
 
 

• After training of the products and equipment, you will be further guided by an experienced manager in the field to introduce the products to new and existing customers in the life science market. 

• You visit new customers and maintain contacts with existing customers.You listen to their needs, give advice and negotiate price proposals 

• You supervise and follow up demos of equipment / kits with customers in collaboration with the specialists. 

• You visit fairs, participate in seminars or webinars. 

• You meet your colleagues (1 day per month) at the office for team meetings, new product launches, administrative tasks, team building, etc 

• You report to the sales and marketing manager 

Vereisten
 
 

• You have a bachelor or master degree in biochemistry, biotechnology or you have relevant experience in a similar sales position. 

• You have a commercial attitude and you are communicative. 

• You have affinity with biotechnology lab equipment, consumables, reagents. 

• You can organize yourself, you are creative and can take initiative. 

• You speak and write fluently French and English and have a good knowledge of Dutch (is a plus).

Welder - Semi-Automatic - Lokeren 

FUNCTIE OMSCHRIJVING

For a family-run metal workshop specializing in the production of steel doors and windows, we are looking for a semi-automatic welder to join the team. The company is known for its high-quality finishes, attention to detail, and passion for interior design and architecture. Every project is tailor-made — from design to the finished product — with a strong focus on craftsmanship and precision.

Job description:
As a semi-automatic welder, you will help produce steel doors and windows for both interior and exterior applications. You will be responsible for very fine welding work and ensure that every piece meets the highest quality standards.

Your tasks:

• 
Performing fine welding work (semi-automatic)

• 
Filing, grinding, and assembling components

• 
Cleaning and smoothing weld seams

• 
Reading and interpreting technical drawings

• 
Delivering precise, high-quality work

PROFIEL

Profile:

• 
You have experience as a welder or are a motivated school leaver

• 
You can read and understand technical plans

• 
You have a good knowledge of Dutch or English

• 
You enjoy detailed, varied work during day shifts

AANBOD
What’s on offer:
You will join a growing company with a strong reputation in the steel and interior design sector. You’ll work in a modern workshop alongside colleagues who value craftsmanship and quality.

STUDIEVEREISTEN
Geen specifieke studievereisten
.

Packaging Meat - 2-Shift - Oudenaarde  

FUNCTIE OMSCHRIJVING

We are looking for Meat Production Workers for a growing food company!

The company processes ham and packages it for various supermarket chains.

The job is not physically demanding!

Early shift: 5:00 a.m.–1:30 p.m.

Late shift: 1:30 p.m.–10:00 p.m.

You get a half-hour break.

PROFIEL

What are your responsibilities?

• As a packer, you will slice and package ham
• Work in cold/cool temperatures
• You will work in the Oudenaarde area
• You will speak in English, Polish or Ukrainian with your colleagues

AANBOD

What do we offer you?

• We offer competitive and fair compensation, and there is no mandatory collective leave.
• You can schedule your time off as you wish.
• A quick start is possible.
• You’ll work on a weekly contract basis, and after a successful temporary assignment, you’ll be offered a permanent contract.

Geen specifieke studievereisten

Robert Half is looking for a Marketing Coordinator (m/v/x) for a company in Brussels-Zellik.

Our client is an international and innovative organization active in a technical B2B environment. The company combines a strong global presence with a hands-on local approach and is currently looking for a versatile marketing professional to support its activities in the French market.

Your responsibilities

• You create, schedule, and manage social media content across platforms such as LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube.
• You write and edit engaging marketing content for email campaigns and digital communication channels.
• You coordinate the development of French-language case studies and customer testimonial content.
• You pre-qualify incoming leads and contact prospects with relevant discovery questions before transferring them to the sales team.
• You support the organization of trade fairs, customer events, demonstrations, and other commercial initiatives in the French region.
• You translate marketing materials from English into French, including brochures, flyers, and technical documentation.
• You help manage CRM activities, including email sequences, templates, and user support for the sales team.
• You provide administrative support linked to sales and marketing activities.

You recognize yourself in the following

• You hold a bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
• You have at least 1 year of experience in marketing or sales support; internships may also be considered.
• You have a strong interest in a B2B and ideally technical or industrial environment.
• You are a native French speaker, and you are fluent in English, both written and spoken.
• You are experienced with social media platforms in a professional context.
• You work comfortably with Microsoft Office, especially PowerPoint and Excel.
• Knowledge of HubSpot or another CRM system is a strong asset.
• You have excellent writing skills and a very strong command of French spelling and grammar.
• You are eager to learn, well-organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
• You can work independently while maintaining strong collaboration with local and international teams.
